child_list.content: The Ant and the Grasshopper
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
In summer, the ant worked hard every day, collecting food for winter. The grasshopper laughed and played, saying, “Why are you working so hard? Come play with me!” But the ant kept working. When winter came, the ant had lots of food and was cozy in its home. The grasshopper had no food and was cold. He went to the ant’s house and asked for help. The ant shared its food, teaching the grasshopper about

the importance of work. From then on, the grasshopper learned to work hard. And they both prepared for winter together.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

child_list.content: 蚂蚁和蚱蜢
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 夏天里，蚂蚁每天都很努力地工作，为冬天收集食物。蚱蜢笑着玩耍，说：“你为什么这么辛苦工作？来和我一起玩吧！”但蚂蚁继续工作。当冬天来临时，蚂蚁有很多食物，在家里很舒适。蚱蜢没有食物，很冷。他去蚂蚁的家里求助。蚂蚁分给蚱蜢一些食物，教导他工作的重要性。从那以后，蚱蜢学会了努力工作。他们一起为冬天做准备。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
